title: Wall Mount Tumbler Toothbrush Holder 5-Inch Projection Solid Brass | Matte Gray | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom sink area with a wall mount tumbler toothbrush holder that saves counter space while keeping essentials within easy reach in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials.

  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: Built from brass for sturdy everyday use.
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware helps maintain a streamlined appearance.
  • Finish flexibility: Available in multiple designer finish options to coordinate with your bathroom.
  • Hardware included: Includes installation hardware.

Specs

  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 4.5 in (L) x 3.5 in (W) x 4.7 in (H)
  • Projection: 5 in
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Included: Toothbrush holder and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
